run_aggregate_metrics: run aggregate_metrics on an output directory to compute and print keypoint tracking evaluation results
run_compute_metrics: run _compute_metrics with ground truth and tracked keypoints to get keypoint errors and accelerations
run_load_eval_main: run the load_eval module directly to evaluate known and unknown skeleton tracking results
review_Metrics_dataclass: review the Metrics dataclass that holds keypoint errors, keypoint accelerations, and ground truth accelerations
test_compute_metrics: test _compute_metrics function with numpy arrays for ground truth keypoints, tracked keypoints, and valid tracking masks
